description: Use this when the user has not chosen a destination country and describes the trip in words (season, budget, interests, travellers). Gives indicative prices of destination ideas, not the offers of search_packages. Suggests holiday destinations for a natural-language request (e.g. 'warm beach in November with small children'). Returns destination ideas with an indicative package price for the whole group of travellers in the request (not per person), the reason each one matches, and the countryCode that search_packages accepts. Suited to requests without a chosen destination country. Read-only.

query.description: What the user is looking for, in one or two short sentences, including the constraints that apply to this search (e.g. 'sunny beach holiday in June from Warsaw, 2 adults and a 5-year-old, under 6000 PLN').
